summary: Web app down during the morning peak
detail: 07:12 503s across the board. Session store migration from overnight (CHG-0418) sized the connection pool for the old cache cluster, web tier ran out of connections once morning load hit. Rolled back 10:46, recovered immediately.
root_cause: Connection pool sized for the old cache cluster

summary: API report requests timing out on long queries
detail: Reports taking more than ~30s started failing with 504. Gateway upgrade (CHG-0402) reset the upstream idle timeout to the 30s default, previous config was 120s. Fixed by restoring the timeout.
root_cause: Upstream idle timeout reset to default on gateway upgrade

summary: SFTP host key mismatch on one gateway node
detail: About 1 in 3 connections failing host key verification. Cert rotation (CHG-0447) didn't take on one of the three gateway nodes, kept serving the old cert until restarted.
root_cause: Cert rotation not picked up on one node until restart

detail: Runs stuck in CALCULATING for ~20 min. One worker deadlocked on a lock held by a cancelled job. Restarted the worker, cleared immediately. No runs failed, no payments delayed.
root_cause: Lock held by a cancelled job, never released

summary: Run detail screen slow for large customers
detail: Customers over 1000 employees, run detail screen taking up to 40s to render. Unindexed sort on the redesigned screen (CHG-0388). Added the index.
root_cause: Missing index on the per-employee status query

summary: Slovak payments delayed by one value date
detail: Payments to the new Slovak partner (CHG-0374) went out after that partner's earlier cut-off, settled a day late. Routing config still had the old partner's cut-off time.
root_cause: Cut-off time not updated for the second banking partner

detail: Runs validated twice, rejection report lists each rejected row twice. Cosmetic only, underlying run data fine.
root_cause: Report built from validation attempts rather than the run

detail: Run summary showed cut-off in UTC instead of CET, looked 2h earlier than actual. No runs affected but 2 customers approved early because of it.
root_cause: Timezone not applied when rendering the cut-off
